_metadata.description: The headline: branding validation delivered as a first-class test-genie delegated phase via ScenarioValidationService, emitting findings on FINDING_SOURCE_BRANDING with a maturity ladder and deterministic auto-fixes.

requirements.title: Serve ScenarioValidationService for the test-genie branding phase
requirements.description: The scenario implements ValidateScenario/PreviewFix/ApplyFix from ScenarioValidationService so test-genie can consume branding as a delegated phase over Connect, with findings carrying FINDING_SOURCE_BRANDING.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/validation/service_test.go once ScenarioValidationService is implemented.

requirements.title: Evaluate the branding rule set into severity-gated findings
requirements.description: ValidateScenario runs the branding rules (has-display-name, has-logo, has-favicon, has-color-system, has-typography, wcag-aa-contrast, brand-markers-applied) and returns severity-gated findings for the scenario under test.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/validation/rules_test.go once the branding rule set is implemented.

requirements.title: Return a branding MaturityAssessment ladder
requirements.description: Validation returns a MaturityAssessment placing the scenario on a branding maturity ladder derived from which rules pass, so progress is measurable across runs.

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/validation/maturity_test.go once the maturity ladder is implemented.

requirements.title: Offer deterministic, idempotent branding auto-fixes
requirements.description: PreviewFix proposes deterministic fix candidates for fixable findings and ApplyFix applies them such that a second validation finds no remaining candidates (idempotent auto-fix).

validation.notes: Planned unit coverage at api/internal/validation/autofix_test.go once deterministic auto-fix is implemented.
